dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. A true copy of a map of Victoria and Esquimalt. Some of the land in Esquimalt, Victoria, and around James Bay and Victoria Harbour has been divided into a street grid with most street names present along with Songish Village.
